description: Commercialization: Legal pages (이용약관, 개인정보처리방침), security headers, Sentry error tracking setup, production-ready footer with legal links, and enhanced SEO/OG metadata.
steps: Create src/pages/TermsPage.tsx (이용약관): Include service terms for 알비연 링크 covering: service description, membership eligibility (ROTC Business Association members), user responsibilities, content guidelines, service limitations, termination policy, and disclaimer. All in Korean. Follow the Card/PageHeader UI pattern from AboutPage.tsx.

Create src/pages/PrivacyPage.tsx (개인정보처리방침): Include privacy policy covering: data controller info (ROTC 비즈니스연합회), collected data types (name, phone, company, industry), purpose of collection, retention period, third-party sharing policy, user rights (access, correction, deletion), contact for privacy inquiries. Follow Korean Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) format. Use same UI patterns.
Add routes in src/App.tsx for /terms and /privacy pages (public, no auth required).
Update src/pages/HomePage.tsx footer section: add links to /terms and /privacy alongside existing /about link. Also add a version display (v1.0.0) and copyright notice '© 2025 ROTC 비즈니스연합회'.
Update vercel.json to add security headers: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy (restrict camera, microphone, geolocation unless needed).

Add Sentry browser SDK integration: install @sentry/react, create src/lib/sentry.ts with lazy initialization (only when VITE_SENTRY_DSN env var is set), wrap ErrorBoundary.tsx to report errors to Sentry, add VITE_SENTRY_DSN placeholder to .env.production (commented out).
Update public/manifest.webmanifest: add categories field and related_applications for store links (placeholders).
Create public/robots.txt allowing all crawlers with sitemap reference.
Update index.html: add structured data (JSON-LD Organization schema) for SEO.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with all new pages and Sentry integration
HomePage footer has links to terms, privacy, about
Sentry integration is conditional (no-op without DSN)
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm success with no TypeScript errors
